g.title: MlQube: Identity, authentication and authorization
g.text: 2 · Single sign-on through IAM Identity Center · groups per tenant · no static cloud keys for workloads

a.xlink:title: ④ permission set → IAM role → access entry

g.title: legend
g.text: Users reach the portals over the corporate network / VPN, through a private ALB (TLS from ACM)
IAM Identity Center signs the user in (MFA) and sends a SAML assertion with the group IDs to Dex; Dex gives each tool an OIDC token with the groups
Each tool maps groups to tenant roles: admins / developers / viewers of their own tenant only
kubectl: Identity Center permission set → IAM role → EKS access entry; RBAC + Capsule limit users to their tenant's namespaces
Every object is checked at admission by Kyverno and Capsule (tenant labels, quotas, allowed images)
Workloads: tenant ServiceAccount → EKS Pod Identity → per-tenant IAM role → only that tenant's AWS resources
